crossRefs.note: These were the five hundred fifty chief officers who were over Solomon’s work, who ruled over the people who labored in…
Solomon counted out seventy thousand men to bear burdens, eighty thousand men who were stone cutters in the mountains…

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: besides Solomon’s chief officers who were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, who ruled over the people who labored in the work.
translations.bsb: not including his 3,300 foremen who supervised the workers.
translations.kjv: Beside the chief of Solomon's officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.
translations.asv: besides Solomon's chief officers that were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, who bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.
